title: Yellow Crunchy Indian Pecan Nuts Vada
description: A crunchy and flavorful Indian dish featuring pecan nuts, perfect for a date night, with a mustardy taste and a tandoor twist, this low-fat-friendly vada is a delicious and healthy option.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chickpea flour, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt.
Add the chopped pecan nuts, lemon juice, and water to the bowl and mix until a thick batter forms.
Using your hands, shape the batter into small vada shapes.
Place the vada on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Flip the vada over and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the vada from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Yellow Crunchy Indian Pecan Nuts Vada hot and enjoy!
